Second case in hotsrm: `srm_supplier` (OWD `public_read`). Category managers must edit suppliers they don't own (legacy suppliers imported by an admin, hotsrm#15), so their permission set got `modifyAllRecords: true` with `allowDelete: false`, and they can now delete any supplier, which cascades to its contacts and certificates through `master_detail`. Same need as above: edit all, delete none.
